name: External Post Trade Derivative 1 Code
definition: Information related to the post trade of derivatives.

ILQD.name: Illiquid Instrument Transaction
ILQD.definition: Flag for transactions executed under the deferral for instruments for which there is not a liquid market.

LRGS.name: Post Trade LIS Transaction
LRGS.definition: Flag for transactions large in scale relative to normal market size, executed under a permitted post-trade deferral.

SIZE.name: Post Trade SSTI Transaction
SIZE.definition: Flag for transactions executed under the post-trade size specific to the instrument deferral|.

DEFF.name: Deferral
DEFF.definition: Flag for transactions in ETCs, ETNs, SFPs and emission allowances, which benefit from a deferral.
